omissions.what: Official MS gives an alternative method for the M1 mark: 'Standard deviation = sqrt((41033 - 100*'18.91'^2)/99)'. Only the first form (sqrt(41033/100 - (1891/100)^2)) is transcribed.

Official MS A1ft note for the standardisation mark includes 'or clear use of symmetry e.g. (0.9965-0.5)x2. Do not allow use of negative limits.' This alternative/condition is missing from the transcribed A1ft note.
